spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (हिलति)
To express amorous inclination, to dally, to wanton, to sport amorously.

f. (-चिः-ची)
A potherb, (Hingtsha repens.)
E.
हिल sporting, मुच्च to loosen, इन् aff., ङीष् optionally added; also with कन् added, fem. form, हिलभोचिका.

n. (-कं)
Rum, spirits distilled from molasses.
